description: Capability for the main window. Empty on purpose. S1-04 added two app-defined commands (get_service_status, check_service_health, registered via invoke_handler in lib.rs) that the frontend does call via invoke() -- but Tauri v2's capability/ACL system gates PLUGIN-provided commands (core:*, fs:*, shell:*, http:*, ...), not an app's own #[tauri::command] functions, so those two commands need no permission entry here and this stays empty. Verified empirically: `tauri dev` with this empty array still lets the frontend call both commands successfully. No `core:default` bundle (path/event/window/webview/app/image/resources/menu/tray), filesystem, shell, process, or opener permission is granted. S1-04's child-process spawn (the local analysis service) happens entirely in Rust backend setup()/supervisor code -- never through a frontend-exposed capability, and never through shell:open/a sidecar-plugin permission (see app/src-tauri/src/supervisor/process.rs) -- so it required no capability grant either. A file-open-dialog permission is still anticipated by docs/SPRINT_1_BACKLOG.md T-14 for a future ticket; add it, and whichever core:* default a feature actually needs (e.g. core:window:default once window controls are used), only in the ticket that implements that behavior, scoped to that behavior alone.
